app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Gorgious app
body:
Love the app, works well for the goals thing, but some addition will make it even better:

a section where you can journal your day or make a reminder for tomorrow (so expend from just goals). Some other cool additions I would love to see:
For journaling you can have a write function, maybe a foto diary for your progress and do it all in app. 

Maybe a way to connect your health app or calendar with the app and that you can have the option to plan your goals around the activities already in your agenda.
